tool.name: NCBI EGAPx prepare input
tool.description: downloads support data and inputs into a local cache
tool.command: mkdir -p '$output.extra_files_path' && ## Activate Nextflow conda environment and EGAPx Python virtual environment source /galaxy/env.bash && python3 '$__tool_directory__/prepare_egapx_config.py' --output-yaml 'egapx.yaml' --extra-yaml-file '$extra_yaml_file' #if str($cond_input_style.input_style) == "fillform" --stage-dir 'galaxy_staged' --cache-dir '$output.extra_files_path' --export-yaml '$egapx_yaml' @PREPARE_FILLFORM_ARGS@ #else --base-yaml '$cond_input_style.yamlin' #end if && python3 /galaxy/scripts/galaxy-resource-config.py && python3 /galaxy/egapx/ui/egapx.py #if str($developer.query_limit.query_limit_selector) == "false" --force #end if 'egapx.yaml' --executor galaxy --output 'egapx_out' --download-needed --local-cache '$output.extra_files_path'

has_text.text: Additional YAML must parse to a YAML mapping
